name: The Three Priors
summary: Houndmaster Jaeger, Friar Olaf and Inquisitor Cromwell run the cult for Renathyr. When he falls, whoever lives takes the faith.

stages.journal: Three priors serve the Abbot: a houndmaster, a friar and an inquisitor. Each rises again in the shape of a Night Creature when struck down.
stages.hint: Meet each prior, and decide who lives.

stages.journal: The priors are settled, one way or another.
